description: This file contains benchmarking code for custom tensor operations using PyTorch and functorch, including function definitions, testing, and performance measurement.

methods.name: nnc_add
methods.description: Performs element-wise addition of two tensors, decorated with pointwise_operator.

methods.name: nnc_addnorm
methods.description: Performs a fused add-normalization operation on tensors, decorated with pointwise_operator.

methods.name: eager_addnorm
methods.description: Normal addition and normalization function without JIT.

methods.name: maybe_synced
methods.description: Wraps a function to synchronize CUDA if CUDA is enabled.

methods.name: benchmark_loop
methods.description: Runs benchmarking for setup functions, measuring execution time.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Tests the equivalence of a custom operator and a standard tensor operation.

methods.name: test_inplace
methods.description: Tests in-place versions of tensor operations.

methods.name: test_out
methods.description: Tests tensor operations with output tensors.

methods.name: test_backwards
methods.description: Tests backward propagation correctness for tensor operations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function executing a series of benchmarks and generating a results DataFrame.
